verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer. Assistants pick the right tool from natural-language requests and can be scoped to spaces, and a separate remote docs MCP supports agents building integrations. Community reports independently confirm heavy real-world use of Supermemory MCP (60k+ daily users). Missing for 10: step-by-step connection and configuration instructions for specific MCP clients, and a clearly documented auth model (a community post describes a URL-as-key, no-signin design, while the docs speak of authorized context).
